scripts.deploy:app: cd apps/app && npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name pubilo-miniapp --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:web:safe: npm run verify:release-guards && npm run verify:web-delete-tools && npx wrangler pages deploy "apps/web" --project-name pubilo-web-prod --commit-dirty=true
scripts.ext:start: lsof -ti:35729 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; bun run scripts/watch-extension.ts > /tmp/pubilo-ext-watch.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/pubilo-ext-watch.pid && sleep 0.5 && echo '✅ Hot reload running in background (PID:' $(cat /tmp/pubilo-ext-watch.pid) ')'
scripts.ext:stop: kill $(cat /tmp/pubilo-ext-watch.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null && rm -f /tmp/pubilo-ext-watch.pid && echo '🛑 Hot reload stopped' || echo '⚠️ Not running'
scripts.ext:status: kill -0 $(cat /tmp/pubilo-ext-watch.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Running (PID:' $(cat /tmp/pubilo-ext-watch.pid) ')' || echo '⚠️ Not running'
